summary: Textures, render targets and buffers: format admission, Texture2D/3D/Cube transfer and readback, FromStream, cube targets, RenderTargetUsage, vertex/index buffers and layouts. Partly stale against TARGET (core graphics files are byte-identical to the Bible pin, so several claims were already wrong there): FromStream accepts only PNG/JPEG/GIF via stb_image, typed and template transfers exist, RenderTargetCube::Dispose guards bound targets, unchanged bindings are a no-op, Headless/Software/cube-readback and buffer-options claims changed. The site had the user guides, tutorial 152 and the resources internals page; it lacked per-resource profile tables, the transfer-window and CPU-shadow semantics, cube/volume readback, usage contents rules, buffer option handling and the lifetime figure, now on five deep dives.

concepts.section: Textures and Render Targets
concepts.text: Texture and render-target APIs are shared across renderers, but native formats, readback, mip levels, multisampling and attachments differ per family, so a format enumerator, a transfer route, native storage and render-target capability must be treated as separate claims.

concepts.text: Texture exposes Format and LevelCount plus public static size helpers that FNA keeps internal, because content readers, renderers and tests need the byte and block rules.

concepts.text: GetBlockSizeSquaredEXT returns 16 for the six block-compressed formats (4x4 blocks) and 1 for the 21 uncompressed ones, throwing std::out_of_range for a value outside the enum.

concepts.text: GetFormatSizeEXT gives bytes per block or texel: 8 for Dxt1, 16 for the other block formats and Vector4, 1, 2, 4 or 8 for the rest.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: GetPixelStoreAlignment is min(8, format size), the OpenGL 2.1 limit for GL_PACK_ALIGNMENT and GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT.

concepts.text: ValidateGetDataFormat throws std::invalid_argument when the destination element size does not evenly divide the format size.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: A block-compressed level is allocated as ceil(w/4) x ceil(h/4) x block bytes, never as w x h texels.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: A Texture2D with an explicit format is admitted only if the GraphicsProfile and the selected renderer both allow the format; there is no compile-time special case any more.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: The profile is asked first and refuses with XNA's NotSupportedException, so a profile refusal is distinguishable from a renderer refusal; the tables are described in CNA's source as measured on the XNA 4.0 runtime.
tokens: measured on the real XNA 4.0 runtime

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: Under Reach a Texture2D accepts nine formats (Color, the three packed 16-bit formats, DXT1/3/5, NormalizedByte2/4) and refuses the other eleven XNA formats; HiDef refuses none.
concepts.note: Also summarised in Tutorial 152.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: The renderer answers with a tri-state verdict: Supported, Unsupported or Defer; a plain Boolean would force every renderer to restate the framework rule.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: Defer delegates to the framework rule Texture::ValidateFormat, which admits SurfaceFormat::Color only and throws std::runtime_error for anything else.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: An explicit Unsupported verdict on a Texture2D throws std::runtime_error naming the ordinal and the renderer's promotion gate; cubes, volumes and targets throw NotSupportedException.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: Render targets ask a separate verdict (ClassifyRenderTargetFormatEXT) because renderability is narrower than storage.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: Reach and HiDef edge limits (2048 and 4096, through the renderer's profile default) and a 2048:1 aspect-ratio limit are enforced before any native allocation.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: The renderer's real maximum dimension is checked before creation because native validation layers are advisory or lazy.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: Under Reach a non-power-of-two Texture2D may be neither mipmapped nor DXT-compressed, and DXT dimensions must be multiples of four on both profiles.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: TextureCube and Texture3D apply their own profile rules: cube edges 512 (Reach, power of two) or 4096, volumes refused under Reach and capped at 256 per axis under HiDef.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: Render targets reject block-compressed storage at both profiles: the render-target table is the Texture2D table minus DXT1/3/5.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: Several families promote formats beyond Color (Vulkan, WebGPU, SDL_GPU, Direct3D 11/12, Software, and also EasyGL and OpenGL 4); every other family defers to Color only.
concepts.note: The Bible list omits EasyGL and OpenGL4, which classify formats themselves.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: The exact result can depend on the device: Vulkan classifies from vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties for the usage bits its texture path needs.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: The portable baseline stays RGBA8 Color; a wider claim needs a capability query plus a real construction and transfer test, and an unknown usage bit is a question, not a no.
tokens: a question to test, not as a no

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: Claim that Texture2D::FromStream recognises DXT1/3/5 DDS data: at the snapshot the classic FromStream rejects DDS, and the explicit CNAEXT DDSFromStreamEXT decodes it or keeps native blocks.
concepts.note: SOFTWARE-306 removed silent DDS auto-detection from classic FromStream.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: The cube profile table excludes NormalizedByte2/4 at both profiles but deliberately does not enforce Reach's HiDef-only list, so a float cube (image-based lighting) is legal on the default profile.
concepts.note: TARGET fact the Bible compresses.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: CNA's seven EXT formats are left to the renderer: IsFormatAllowedByProfileEXT returns true for them at both profiles.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: TextureCube has its own verdict because one classifier serving 2D and cube once promised a compressed cube that every SetData then refused (WEBGPU-163).

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: A separate colour-transfer verdict lets Vulkan refuse Color-shaped transfers over NormalizedByte4 (signed) and DXT (blocks) although the four-byte width rule would admit them.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: Float and half formats may only be sampled with Point filtering; other filters throw from the draw call, matching XNA's VerifyCanDraw timing (engine-layer scope excepted).

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: Blending or masked colour writes into Single, Vector2, Vector4 or the half formats throw at draw time; HdrBlendable is exempt.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: Per-format usage in the capability profile has known and supported masks over thirteen RendererFormatUsage bits; a missing known bit means unclassified, not unsupported.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: The device's TextureStorage bit is the renderer verdict without the profile gate, while its RenderTarget bit includes the profile, so under Reach storage can be reported for a format the constructor refuses.
tokens: does not include the profile gate

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: Vulkan, SDL_GPU, OpenGL 4 and WebGPU add audited per-format usage through GetSurfaceFormatUsageSupportEXT; others report only the three device-classified bits.

concepts.section: Texture formats: profile gate, renderer verdict, native storage
concepts.text: Compressed content stays compressed only when the renderer both transfers blocks (IsCompressedTransferFormatEXT) and prefers compressed loads (LoadsCompressedContentNativelyEXT); otherwise loaders decode to Color.

concepts.section: Two SetData paths, and why GetData can hide a failed upload
concepts.text: HasDefinedMipLevel lets a renderer own readable bytes for an unauthored level; only then does GetData read that level from the renderer (EasyGL, OpenGL 4, SDL_GPU, FNA3D, Metal, Software, Direct2D override it).

concepts.section: Two SetData paths, and why GetData can hide a failed upload
concepts.text: A mipmapped Texture2D owns the complete chain; upper levels are authored, and CNA does not promise renderer-generated mips.

concepts.section: Two SetData paths, and why GetData can hide a failed upload
concepts.text: Compressed transfers use texel-space rectangles that must be block-aligned or reach the level edge, an exact padded byte count, and no CPU shadow (read, patch, re-upload).

concepts.section: RenderTargetUsage: three values, more than three behaviors
concepts.text: Claim that DiscardContents leaves no readable replacement: CNA clears the first bound target to colour (0,0,0,255), depth 1.0 and stencil 0 on every bind.
concepts.note: Also added to the user guide as an expansion.

concepts.section: RenderTargetUsage: three values, more than three behaviors
concepts.text: PreserveContents and PlatformContents both map to preserve in RenderTargetUsagePreservesContentsEXT; only DiscardContents discards.

concepts.section: RenderTargetUsage: three values, more than three behaviors
concepts.text: That mapping is FNA's rule: both non-discard values reach the native layer as a preserve request.

concepts.section: RenderTargetUsage: three values, more than three behaviors
concepts.text: Before the shared helper, targets passed usage == PreserveContents while the device cleared only DiscardContents, so PlatformContents was both preserved and discarded (REMED-GFX-136).

concepts.section: RenderTargetUsage: three values, more than three behaviors
concepts.text: An explicit Clear inside a bind cycle is an ordered command that wins over the usage policy aspect by aspect (REMED-GFX-129).

concepts.section: RenderTargetUsage: three values, more than three behaviors
concepts.text: Cube targets use the normalised binding path; RenderTargetBindingDescriptor carries the face, dimensions, applied sample count and renderer; usage reaches the cube factory.

concepts.section: RenderTargetUsage: three values, more than three behaviors
concepts.text: Claim that WebGPU rejects MRT: WebGPU binds sets of two to four RenderTarget2Ds and refuses only a cube face inside a set.

concepts.section: RenderTargetUsage: three values, more than three behaviors

concepts.section: RenderTargetUsage: three values, more than three behaviors

concepts.section: RenderTargetUsage: three values, more than three behaviors
concepts.text: Vulkan's multi-target render pass begins colour attachments with a clear from an undefined layout (except split continuations), so PreserveContents is not kept in an MRT set there.

concepts.section: RenderTargetUsage: three values, more than three behaviors

issues.text: PresentationParameters.RenderTargetUsage is stored and exposed but never consulted when returning to the back buffer.
Vulkan multi-target render passes clear every colour attachment from an undefined layout, so PreserveContents/PlatformContents targets lose content when bound in an MRT set.
Canvas and FreeDirect texture renderers throw for any mip level above 0.
The former options-path shadow defect in Dynamic*Buffer::SetData is absent at TARGET (single upload path).
Disposing an untracked Texture2D/TextureCube value copy raises GraphicsDevice.ResourceDestroyed without a matching ResourceCreated.
Headless validates cube uploads but stores nothing; cube SetData throws NotSupportedException there, so cube content paths cannot be exercised on HEADLESS.
